theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Fin m → (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ)), ∃ (μ₀ : Measure X) (ρ : Fin m → X → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (ρ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn (ρ i) K μ₀) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin m) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), Λ₁ i f - Λ₂ i f = ∫ x, f x * ρ i x ∂μ₀
